description: Copy a PDF from another site onto a wiki page by its link — an article a conspectus cites, kept here in case it disappears there. The server fetches it: an https address on the public internet only, a PDF by its bytes, at most 50 MB. The copy is attached to the page (pageId, or spaceKey + title) under 'filename' or the address's own name, with where it came from and when; the page's history says who copied it. It is the project's working copy: shown to the project's members, and to a reader from outside a public project only as the link to the original. Once attached, pdf_page_image shows its pages, search finds its words, and «Recognize with formulas» (recognize_pdf) can read it with its formulas. Requires permission to edit the page.

filename.description: The name to keep it under, e.g. 'toda-2003.pdf'. The address's own name otherwise.

spaceKey.description: Space key, when identifying the page by title.

title.description: Exact page title, when identifying the page by title.

name: copy_pdf_to_wiki
title: Copy pdf to wiki
